description: This file provides static compatibility methods for different PHP versions, including object copying, identity testing, type comparison, reference checking, class hierarchy checking, and socket timeout setting.

classes.name: SimpleTestCompatibility
classes.description: A class providing static methods for compatibility across different PHP versions, including object copying, identity checks, type comparisons, reference checks, class hierarchy checks, and socket timeout configuration.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of an object, compatible with PHP4 and PHP5.

methods.name: isIdentical
methods.description: Checks if two variables are identical, considering PHP version differences.

methods.name: _isIdenticalType
methods.description: Recursively checks if two variables are of the same type and structure.

methods.name: _isArrayOfIdenticalTypes
methods.description: Recursively compares two arrays for identical types and values.

methods.name: isReference
methods.description: Checks if two variables are references (aliases).

methods.name: isA
methods.description: Checks if an object is a member of a specified class hierarchy.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a socket timeout for a given handle, compatible with multiple PHP functions.
